Indonesia's tech sector remains tethered to domestic consumption and fintech, not global AI capex, so its +0.61% move is a lagging indicator—expect catch-up only if IDX liquidity improves.
sectors.ai: Buy the US tech surge selectively: Palantir, Zebra, and Arm are leading on AI monetization and edge-hardware re-rating, while Indonesia's +0.61% lag signals local names are not yet repricing. Rotate into US-listed AI infrastructure (MRVL, ALAB, COHR) for beta, but add Indonesian tech exposure only on a confirmed IDX rally—current divergence favors US over ID for the next 2-4 weeks.

themes: Indonesia's nickel downstreaming policy continues to drive vertically integrated renewable and EV supply chain investments, benefiting TOBA's battery materials segment.

Domestic EV adoption is accelerating in Indonesia, with VKTR's commercial vehicle focus capitalizing on fleet electrification mandates and infrastructure buildout.

US solar names (SEDG, ENPH, FSLR) confirm global demand strength. Accumulate TOBA for nickel-integrated EV battery exposure and VKTR for commercial EV adoption, targeting 15% upside over 3 months.

Regulatory easing on food and beverage permits is lowering entry costs, driving M&A and consolidation among listed micro-caps with brand assets.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap consumer names with confirmed volume breakouts (ENZO, PADA, MBTO) into Q4 domestic demand strength, but keep tight stops given WATCH signal and 1% ID/US divergence. Rotate out of laggards (AGAR, UDNG) toward names with earnings catalysts or new product cycles. Trim if IDX consumer breadth fails to hold above +0.85% aggregate for two sessions.

sectors.ai: Buy the momentum in TALF, BRNA, and KETR—these are high-beta plays on Indonesia's accelerated toll-road and energy-transmission capex cycle, with foreign inflows amplifying upside. Trim SOFA and MIRA into strength; their gains are sentiment-driven, not earnings-backed. Rotate into LDOS and RGAS for defensive exposure to state-linked construction and gas distribution, which benefit from Jokowi's legacy projects continuing under Prabowo.
